sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 15:73

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 15:73:1
items.html: Everything that the male gives to the Nukva at the time of the sawing, even what is given to her from Ima, is only the Gevurot, and they are called posterior. For both the Gevurot that were given to her through the illumination of the name BON by means of Ima and not by means of ZA — which is the first coupling of BON, that completes the AHP of the Nukva, as above in the adjacent item — and the second coupling of BON, which likewise sweetens the AHP of the Nukva with a greater wholeness: behold, both of them come only to complete the vessels of her posterior, which are the AHP, as above, and therefore both of them are regarded as the discernment of posterior, and likewise as the discernment of BON. Only the second coupling, which is by means of ZA and which gives her the lights themselves, is what is regarded as the discernment of face and as the discernment of MA, as above in the adjacent item.
